blocks.title: What it may do once enabled
blocks.description: Install modules only from authors you know. Once enabled, a module does what is listed here without asking you again: it reaches these sites, reads these secrets, works in these folders and calls these models. deck checks nothing more.
blocks.empty: Nothing beyond its own records: it reaches no site, reads no secret and calls no model

blocks.title: Enable
blocks.description: Until then it is a draft: nothing runs by itself, and only its trials run.
